license_note: Original questions and curated answer matrix. Character names and brands remain their owners' property; no affiliation is implied. No Akinator database was used.
portrayal_policy: Best-known mainstream portrayals. Use UNKNOWN for conflicts, missing knowledge or distinctions that would require niche lore. Appearance uses the named familiar portrayal, not every costume or adaptation. Inherited defaults are not independently verified. Cell-level evidence and corrections are in data/COVERAGE.JSON and data/CHANGES.JSON. Audit05: debut questions use the named version. Film-specific profiles use that adaptation; generic book/comic/game identities retain their original medium. Appearance alone does not redefine an identity. All pre-existing UNKNOWN cells remain UNKNOWN.

audit_kirby.facts: Pink, inhales enemies, copies abilities, strongly food-associated. This profile supplies no age. Absence of age does not establish old or young.

audit_harry.facts: Wizard, Hogwarts student; magical adventures with Ron/Hermione; Quidditch Seeker; Invisibility Cloak, flying and world-saving.

audit_hermione.facts: Witch, Hogwarts student; magic, Time-Turner, special bag, Crookshanks care and house-elf rights campaigning.

audit_ron.facts: Red-haired Hogwarts student; seven-child Weasley family, Harry/Hermione trio, Quidditch Keeper, food and flying-car associations.

audit_quidditch.facts: Broom-flight sport with scoring through hoops and several balls; Harry/Ron listed as connections.

audit_dracula.facts: Bram Stoker's literary Count Dracula is a Transylvanian noble associated with a castle. Counting a count as royal is a taxonomy decision, not a fact established by the word noble.
